title: 第22章 学成辞别第23章 回家
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
第二天一早，天刚蒙蒙亮，卓然就起床在院子里面练功了，扎着马步吞吐纳气，吸收着天地灵气！老庄在房间里面看着这一切，不住的点头！大约过了半个时辰以后，老庄走出房间对卓然说道“然儿，之前你所学的都是打基础的武功，今天师父就教你真正的武功，你先站在一边，师父先练一遍，你仔细看，随后师父再把运行心法告诉你！”说完以后他就来到院子中央，就见他气定神闲，拉开架势瞬间就见人影翻飞，闪转腾挪，静如处子，动如脱兔。卓然在一旁看的眼睛都直了！很快老庄一套掌法打完，只见他脸不红，气不喘！看着卓然说道“从今天开始你练这套掌法，等你掌握了师父再教你一套剑法！”卓然点了点头。
就在卓然练这套掌法的时间，颜辰龙带着他的小儿子颜明达过来了，颜辰龙先是给老庄请了个早安！随后老庄让颜明达练了一套掌法看看，颜明达从小就在父亲的教导下练习武功，只见他那套掌法打的也是虎虎生风，干净利索，打完以后老庄也是赞不绝口，从这以后二人就在这小院子里面一起练武，一起读书，老庄和颜辰龙看着他们两人一起进步，也很是开心！在老庄的静心指导下，两人武功都突飞猛进，两人在一起过招也都是旗鼓相当，由于卓然的内力比颜明达要深厚，所以他们对练的时候，老庄是不允许他们用内力的，怕他们两人受伤，关键是由于颜明达的内力不够，所以有的武功他没有办法修习，如果强行修炼反而会起到反作用，但是卓然由于小时候吞服过一粒洗经增元丹的缘故，他现在已经身负三十多年的内力，很多需要内力催动的高深武功他可以练。所以真实战力卓然比颜明达要高了太多！但是老庄一直都不让卓然展示出来。春去秋来，很快三年就过去了！卓然已经到了十八岁了，已经长成一个英俊潇洒的少年了！
这天卓然和颜明达对练结束以后，正在休息的时候，老庄把卓然单独喊过去说道“卓然！离开陈刘庄也已经三年了，现在我能教你的也都教给你了，还有一套剑法和一套掌法，你内力不够，等到你打通任督二脉，就可以修习了！我全部写在一本书上了，你带在身上，明天师父想让你回去看看你娘和你蔡爷爷。”卓然闻言说道“师父！您和我一起去吗？”老庄呵呵一笑说道“卓然！师父还有其他事情，就不去了，你自己回去！”卓然说道“师父您这是要赶我走了吗？”老庄呵呵一笑说道“傻孩子！天下没有不散的宴席，师父能教你的都教给你了，你现在的武功可以去闯荡一下了，你现在已经学成了，该去查一下当年卓大帅遇害的事情了！”卓然听完老庄的话以后，心里可以说是五味杂陈，里面有对师父的不舍，有对母亲的思念，更多的是仇恨！一直压在他心头的仇恨！卓然说道“师父！我什么时候能再见到您老人家呀？”老庄呵呵一笑说道“师父想你的时候就去找你了，晚上吃饭的时候我和你大师兄说这事，让他安排一匹马给你还是马车呀？”卓然说道“我就一个人，还是骑马吧！”
到了晚上吃饭的时候，老庄把卓然要回去的事情说了一下，颜辰龙说道“小师弟离家三年了，回去看看也是人之常情，我明天安排一匹好马给师弟！”颜明达则是一脸的不舍看着卓然，毕竟两人在一起朝夕相处三年的时间了，感情一直都很好！颜明达说道“小师叔！你走了我会想你的！”卓然呵呵一笑说道“我也会想你们的！”说完拍了拍颜明达的肩膀！颜辰龙又说道“小师弟！你那两个师侄，现在生意做的不错，不少地方都有买卖，你以后有需要可以去店里让他们帮忙！那两师侄你都认识的，等过年他们回来以后，我和他们两人说这事，记住是永盛的字号，你只要说你名字就可以了！”卓然说道“这个就没有必要了吧？”颜辰龙说道“有时候难免会有困难的！你记住永盛这个字号就可以了！”卓然闻言只好点了点头！老庄呵呵一笑说道“卓然！你就听你大师兄的吧！还有一件事情要告诉你，你其他三个师兄，你二师兄名字叫刑战，三师兄叫江如海，四师兄叫冯天刚。以后你们肯定会碰面的！”卓然点头说道“师父我都记住了！”老庄又说道“你所以师兄里面，现在只有你大师兄是不问江湖事了，那三个师兄还没退出江湖了！还是你大师兄这样好呀，与世无争，自得其乐，日子过得逍遥自在！”颜辰龙连忙说道“师父！让您见笑了！”老庄呵呵一笑说道“挺好的，你现在这样挺好的！时间不早了，都回去休息，明天卓然还要赶路！”众人闻言都各自回自己房间。
颜明达则跟着卓然来到房间，颜明达进门就说道“小师叔！过完年我就去找你行不？”卓然呵呵一笑说道“明达！你呢好好的和你两个哥哥学着做生意，不要想东想西的！”颜明达说道“我不喜欢做生意，我希望仗剑走天涯，喜欢行侠仗义，打抱不平那种生活！”卓然听完颜明达的话以后，不由打量了他一下说道“明达！你这样你的父母会担心的！你知道吗？”颜明达闻言说道“好男儿志在四方！我要做一位人人敬仰的大侠客，才对得起我一身所学！”卓然一时竟然无言以对！连忙说道“这些都以后再说吧！你先回去休息，明天我还要赶路呢？”颜明达说道“今天晚上我就在你这里睡了！明天你就要回去了，我想多陪陪你！”这三年他们就经常在一起睡觉，所以颜明达才这样说。卓然说道“你在这睡觉也可以！不要又和我聊一夜！”颜明达连连点头说道“我知道你明天要赶路，不会聊那么晚的！”卓然看着他无奈的摇了摇头！
content_en:
Early the next morning, as soon as it was dawn, Zhuo Ran got up and practiced in the yard. He breathed in and out while walking, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth! Lao Zhuang watched all this in the room and kept nodding! About half an hour later, Lao Zhuang walked out of the room and said to Zhuoran, "Ran'er, what you have learned before is the basic martial arts. Today, the master will teach you the real martial arts. You stand aside first, and the master will practice it first. You watch carefully, and then the master will tell you the movement method!" After saying that, he came to the center of the yard, and saw that he was calm and relaxed. The moment he opened his stance, he could see figures flying around, flashing and moving, as quiet as a virgin and as moving as a rabbit. Zhuoran's eyes widened as he watched! Soon Lao Zhuang finished a set of palm techniques, and I saw that his face was not red and he was not panting! Looking at Zhuoran, he said, "Start practicing this palm technique from today. When you master it, the master will teach you a set of sword techniques!" Zhuoran nodded.
While Zhuo Ran was practicing this palm technique, Yan Chenlong came over with his youngest son Yan Mingda. Yan Chenlong first wished Lao Zhuang good morning! Later, Lao Zhuang asked Yan Mingda to practice a set of palm skills. Yan Mingda has been practicing martial arts under the guidance of his father since he was a child. He saw that his palm skills were very powerful and clean. After the fight, Lao Zhuang was full of praise. From then on, the two of them practiced martial arts together in the small yard and studied together. Lao Zhuang and Yan Chenlong were very happy to see them progress together! Under the calm guidance of Lao Zhuang, both of their martial arts improved by leaps and bounds, and they were evenly matched when fighting together. Since Zhuoran's internal strength was deeper than that of Yan Mingda, when they were sparring, Lao Zhuang did not allow them to use their internal strength for fear that they would be injured. The key was because of Yan Mingda's His internal strength is not enough, so he cannot practice some martial arts. If he practices it forcefully, it will have the opposite effect. However, because Zhuoran swallowed a menstrual-cleansing and Yuan-enhancing Pill when he was a child, he now has more than thirty years of internal strength, and he can practice many advanced martial arts that require internal strength. So the real combat power of Zhuoran is much higher than that of Yan Mingda! But Lao Zhuang never let Zhuoran show it. Spring goes and autumn comes, and three years have passed quickly! Zhuoran has reached the age of eighteen and has grown into a handsome young man!
After Zhuoran and Yan Mingda finished sparring that day, while they were resting, Lao Zhuang called Zhuoran over alone and said, "Zhuoran! It has been three years since I left Chenliuzhuang. Now I have taught you everything I can teach you. I also have a set of sword skills and a set of palm skills. You don't have enough internal strength." , you can start practicing after you open up the Ren and Du channels! I wrote it all in a book, take it with you. Tomorrow Master wants you to go back and see your mother and your Grandpa Cai." Zhuo Ran heard this and said, "Master! Will you come with me?" Lao Zhuang said with a smile. Zhuoran! Master has other things to do, so you can go back alone!" Zhuoran said, "Master, are you going to drive me away?" Lao Zhuang laughed and said, "Silly boy! There is no such thing as a banquet. Master has taught you all the martial arts you have now." You can go out and have a try. Now that you have learned your lesson, it’s time to investigate what happened when Marshal Zhuo was killed!" After hearing what Lao Zhuang said, Zhuo Ran felt a mixture of emotions in his heart, including reluctance for his master, longing for his mother, and even more hatred! The hatred that has been weighing on his heart! Zhuoran said, "Master! When can I see you again?" Lao Zhuang laughed and said, "Master went to see you when he missed you. I told your senior brother about this during dinner in the evening and asked him to arrange a horse or a carriage for you?" Zhuoran said, "I am alone, so I better ride a horse!"
At dinner time in the evening, Lao Zhuang told Zhuo Ran about going back. Yan Chenlong said, "Junior brother has been away from home for three years. It is only human nature to go back and take a look. I will arrange a good horse for junior brother tomorrow!" Yan Ming said!Da Ze looked at Zhuoran with a look of reluctance. After all, the two have been together day and night for three years, and their relationship has always been very good! Yan Mingda said, "Uncle! I will miss you when you leave!" Zhuo Ran chuckled and said, "I will miss you too!" After speaking, he patted Yan Mingda on the shoulder! Yan Chenlong then said, "Little brother! Your two nephews are doing good business now, and they are doing business in many places. If you need help in the future, you can go to the store and ask them to help! You know those two nephews. When they come back during the Chinese New Year, I will talk to them about this matter , remember it's Yongsheng's name, you just need to say your name!" Zhuo Ran said, "That's not necessary, right?" Yan Chenlong said, "Sometimes it will be difficult! Just remember the name Yongsheng!" Zhuo Ran nodded after hearing this! Lao Zhuang chuckled and said, "Zhuoran! Just listen to your senior brother! There is one more thing I want to tell you. Your other three senior brothers, your second senior brother's name is Xing Zhan, your third senior brother's name is Jiang Ruhai, and your fourth senior brother's name is Feng Tiangang. You will definitely meet in the future!" Zhuoran nodded and said, "Master, I remember it all!" Lao Zhuang added, "Among all your senior brothers, now you are the only senior brother who does not care about Jianghu. It's okay, those three senior brothers haven't left the world yet! It's better for you, senior brother, to live a happy life without fighting against the world!" Yan Chenlong said quickly, "Master! I made you laugh!" Lao Zhuang said with a smile, "It's getting late, everyone goes back to rest, Zhuoran has to go back to his room tomorrow!"
Yan Mingda followed Zhuo Ran to the room. When Yan Mingda entered the door, he said, "Uncle! I'll go find you after the Chinese New Year, okay?" Zhuo Ran laughed and said, "Mingda! You should learn to do business with your two brothers and don't think about things!" Yan Mingda said, "I don't like doing business. I want to go to the ends of the world with my sword. I like to be a hero. After hearing what Yan Mingda said, Zhuo Ran couldn't help but look at him and said, "Mingda! Your parents will be worried if you do this!" Yan Mingda said after hearing this, "I want to be a great knight that everyone respects, so that I can live up to what I have learned!" He quickly said, "Let's talk about this later! You go back to rest first, I have to travel tomorrow?" Yan Mingda said, "I will sleep at your place tonight! You will go back tomorrow, and I want to spend more time with you!" They have often slept together in the past three years, so Yan Mingda said this. Zhuoran said, "You can sleep here! Don't talk to me all night again!" Yan Mingda nodded repeatedly and said, "I know you have to rush tomorrow and won't talk so late!" Zhuoran looked at him and shook his head helplessly!
